The '''61st Directors Guild of America Awards''', honoring the outstanding directorial achievements in [[film director|film]]s, [[documentary]] and [[television director|television]] in 2008, were presented on January 31, 2009, at the [[Hyatt Regency Century Plaza]].<ref>{{cite web|last1=Finke|first1=Nikki|title='Slumdog' Director Danny Boyle Wins DGA|url=https://deadline.com/2009/01/slumdog-director-danny-boyle-wins-dga-8258/|website=Deadline|access-date=January 20, 2018|date=January 31, 2009}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=King|first1=Susan|title=Directors Guild names Danny Boyle best director for 'Slumdog Millionaire'|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2009-feb-01-me-dga1-story.html|access-date=20 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=February 1, 2009}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=All Winners of 2008 DGA Awards and Special Award Recipients|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2009/0131-All-Winners-of-2008-DGA-Awards-and-Special-Award-Recipients.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 22, 2018|date=January 31, 2009}}</ref> The ceremony was hosted by [[Carl Reiner]].<ref>{{cite web|title=DGA Sets Host and Presenters for 61st Annual DGA Awards Dinner|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2009/0126-DGA-Sets-Host-and-Presenters-for-61st-Annual-DGA-Awards-Dinner.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 20, 2018|date=January 26, 2009}}</ref> The nominees in the feature film category were announced on January 8, 2009,<ref>{{cite news|last1=Garrett|first1=Diane|title=DGA unveils director nominees|url=https://variety.com/2009/film/awards/dga-unveils-director-nominees-1117998201/|access-date=January 20, 2018|work=Variety|date=January 8, 2009}}</ref> and the nominations for directorial achievement in television, documentaries and commercials were announced on January 9, 2009.<ref>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title='Mad Men,' '30 Rock' top DGA noms|url=https://variety.com/2009/tv/awards/mad-men-30-rock-top-dga-noms-1117998279/|access-date=January 20, 2018|work=Variety|date=January 9, 2009}}</ref>
